veille_media.title: Madagascar Media Monitoring
veille_media.description: Automated Data pipeline for collecting, NLP enriching (FR/MG), and analyzing Malagasy press news in real time.
veille_media.details:
Production-grade Data Engineering & NLP Pipeline:
• Multi-source Extraction: Automated fetching from 15+ news outlets (RSS feeds, BeautifulSoup, Selenium) with SHA-256 deduplication.
• Transformation & Multilingual NLP: Language detection (FR/MG), sentiment analysis using Deep Learning (XLM-RoBERTa), and semantic classification (Sentence-Transformers).
• Storage & Data Warehouse: MongoDB Atlas (NoSQL) ➔ Automated batch sync into Google BigQuery.
• Analytics & BI: Workflows orchestrated with Prefect and delivered through an interactive Looker Studio dashboard.

symfony_bi.title: Symfony Analytics Dashboard
symfony_bi.description: Dual-panel BI web application for dynamic parsing, cross-tabulation analysis, and comparison of Excel media surveys.
symfony_bi.details:
Web Business Intelligence & Data Viz Platform:
• Excel Ingestion & Caching: Optimized parsing using PhpSpreadsheet with in-memory caching ($dataCache) for ultra-fast query execution.
• Cross-Tabulation & Timelines: Dynamic matrix computation (Media × Sentiment) and time-series metrics (monthly trends & sentiment polarity).
• Dual-Panel Comparison: Independent dual-filtering dashboard (Year / Month) enabling side-by-side period comparisons.
• Chart.js Integration: Interactive Doughnut charts, KPI cards, and Stacked Bar charts with automated frequency and percentage calculations via DTOs.

file_explorer.title: Web File Explorer & Sync Engine
file_explorer.description: Fullstack Node.js/React platform for directory browsing, file transfers, and automated system folder synchronization into MongoDB.
file_explorer.details:
Web File Management & Synchronization Engine:
• Recursive Sync Engine: Automated scanning and metadata indexing (size, modification date, file type) of local system directories using Node.js (fs/path).
• Security & Path Sanitization: Native protection against Path Traversal vulnerabilities during tree navigation.
• Storage & REST API: Metadata persistence using MongoDB (Mongoose) and multipart upload stream handling via Multer.
• Responsive Interface: Modular React UI supporting directory tree browsing, file uploading, and media previews.
